id: 03_Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory VTU Familiarization of Autotransformer Wires, C
title: 导线、导体与自耦调压器（国内版）
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/03_Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory VTU Familiarization of Autotransformer Wires, C.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/03_Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory VTU Familiarization of Autotransformer Wires, C（国内版）/src.py

points.K8: 良导体、不良导体、非导体
points.K10: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线
points.K13: 导线等于导体加绝缘层
points.S1: 调压器输出不是安全电压
points.S4: 断电接线，教师检查后通电

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台边，台上有一卷卷彩色导线和一台带旋钮的圆形调压器，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with coils of colored wire and a round variable autotransformer with a big knob, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课认识导线、导体和自耦调压器。
overlay: 导线、导体与自耦调压器

shots.scene: 导体、绝缘层、导线、调压器四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a copper strand, an insulating sleeve, a coiled wire and a round voltage regulator with a knob. No people.
shots.narration: 导体、绝缘、导线、调压器。

shots.scene: 阿杰把调压器旋钮拧到很高，就把输出线接到电路上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns the knob of a variable autotransformer far up and is about to connect its output leads to a circuit.
shots.narration: 阿杰把调压器拧到高处，就要接线。

shots.scene: 一根绝缘层破裂、露出铜丝的导线特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a connecting wire with cracked insulation and bare copper strands showing. No people.
shots.narration: 手里那根导线，还露着铜丝。

shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，指向电源开关和旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student and points to the power switch and the knob.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先断电、先回零、换导线。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 导线和调压器，看着简单，学问不少。

shots.scene: 欣欣依次指向四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points one by one at four icons: a conductor, an insulator, a wire and an autotransformer.
shots.narration: 先讲导体和绝缘，再讲导线和调压器。

shots.scene: 金属里很多自由移动的小圆点
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a metal block with many small free-moving dots inside, arrows showing them drifting. No people.
shots.narration: 导体里的自由电子多，容易导电。

shots.scene: 左边圆点密集标绿勾，右边圆点稀少标黄色
shots.prompt_en: Two blocks side by side: left packed with free dots and a green check, right with few dots and a yellow mark. No people.
shots.narration: 电子多，电阻小；电子少，电阻大。

shots.scene: 电阻符号和倒数箭头指向电导符号
shots.prompt_en: A resistor symbol with a flip arrow pointing to a conductance symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 电导是电阻的倒数。

shots.scene: 一张空白卡片上有单位图示
shots.prompt_en: A blank card with a unit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 单位是西门子，旧称姆欧。

shots.scene: 一卷闪亮的铜线
shots.prompt_en: A shiny coil of copper wire on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 铜线导电好，好焊接。

shots.scene: 铜线卷放在天平一侧较重，旁边有钱币图标
shots.prompt_en: A copper coil on a balance scale tipping down, next to a coin stack icon. No people.
shots.narration: 缺点是重一些、贵一些。

shots.scene: 房屋图标里的墙内布线
shots.prompt_en: A house icon with wiring routes drawn inside the walls. No people.
shots.narration: 家里布线常用铜线。

shots.scene: 一卷银灰色铝线，轻轻浮在天平上
shots.prompt_en: A coil of silver-grey aluminum wire on a balance scale tipping up, lighter. No people.
shots.narration: 铝线便宜又轻。

shots.scene: 铜和铝两根导电柱，铝的约为铜的六成
shots.prompt_en: Two conductivity bars: a copper bar full height and an aluminum bar about sixty percent as tall. No people.
shots.narration: 导电率大约是铜的六成。

shots.scene: 粗细不同的四根导线截面圆
shots.prompt_en: Four wire cross-section circles of increasing size side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 导线截面有好几种规格。

shots.scene: 电流箭头穿过导线，粗电流配粗线
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a small current arrow through a thin wire, a big current arrow through a thick wire, both with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 电流大，就选截面大的导线。

shots.scene: 电压表回路接细线，电流回路接粗线
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon with thick wires in the main current loop and thinner wires going to a voltmeter. No people.
shots.narration: 电流回路用粗线，电压测量线可细些。

shots.scene: 一卷灰色镀锌铁线
shots.prompt_en: A coil of dull grey galvanized iron wire. No people.
shots.narration: 镀锌铁线：重，导电最差。

shots.scene: 架空线和接地极两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: overhead line poles with wires, and an earth rod in the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 多用在架空线和接地。

shots.section_title: 良导体、不良导体、非导体
shots.scene: 铜铝导线图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of copper and aluminum wires with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 铜、铝是良导体，电阻小，用来输电。
overlay: 良导体、不良导体、非导体

shots.section_title: 良导体、不良导体、非导体
shots.scene: 发光的灯丝和发红的电热丝
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a glowing lamp filament and a red-hot heating coil. No people.
shots.narration: 钨丝、镍铬丝电阻较大，用来发热发光。

shots.section_title: 良导体、不良导体、非导体
shots.scene: 塑料管和玻璃瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of plastic pipes and a glass bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 塑料、玻璃几乎不导电，用来绝缘。

shots.section_title: 良导体、不良导体、非导体
shots.scene: 导线剖面：中间铜芯，外面塑料皮
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a wire: copper core in the middle, plastic sleeve outside. No people.
shots.narration: 电线把导体和绝缘体组合起来。

shots.scene: PVC、橡胶两种绝缘层样品，天然橡胶打黄色问号
shots.prompt_en: Samples of PVC insulation and vulcanized rubber insulation with green checks, and natural rubber with a yellow question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 绝缘层常用塑料和硫化橡胶。

shots.scene: 天然橡胶样品打叉
shots.prompt_en: A natural rubber sample crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 天然橡胶不宜作导线绝缘。

shots.section_title: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线
shots.scene: 一根粗实心铜芯的剖面
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a cable with one solid copper core. No people.
shots.narration: 实心导线，一根铜芯，常用在电缆里。
overlay: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线

shots.section_title: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线
shots.scene: 几股铜丝绞在一起的导线，轻松弯曲
shots.prompt_en: A wire made of several twisted copper strands bending easily. No people.
shots.narration: 绞合导线由几股绞成，更柔软。

shots.section_title: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线
shots.scene: 很多细铜丝组成的多股线
shots.prompt_en: A wire with many fine copper strands fanned out at the end. No people.
shots.narration: 多股导线，股数多，载流更好。

shots.section_title: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线
shots.scene: 极细铜丝组成的软线，可绕成圈
shots.prompt_en: A very flexible cord made of extremely fine strands, coiled loosely. No people.
shots.narration: 软线丝更细，订购时要说明股数。

shots.scene: 三根导线：单芯单股、单芯多股、双芯多股
shots.prompt_en: Three wire icons: single core single strand, single core multi-strand, and two-core multi-strand. No people.
shots.narration: 还有单芯单股、单芯多股、双芯多股。

shots.scene: 公式卡：电阻等于电阻率乘长度除以截面
shots.prompt_en: A blank card with a formula icon showing resistance proportional to length over area. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻跟长度成正比，跟截面成反比。

shots.scene: 大截面圆打绿勾标低电阻，小截面圆标高电阻
shots.prompt_en: Two cross-section circles: a large one labeled low resistance, a small one labeled high resistance. No people.
shots.narration: 截面大，电阻小；截面小，电阻大。

shots.scene: 长导线和短导线对比
shots.prompt_en: A long wire and a short wire side by side, the long one with a bigger resistance symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 导线越长，电阻越大。

shots.section_title: 导线等于导体加绝缘层
shots.scene: 导线剖面：铜芯 + 外皮，加号连接
shots.prompt_en: An icon equation: a copper core plus an insulating sleeve equals a finished wire. No people.
shots.narration: 导线，就是导体加绝缘层。
overlay: 导线等于导体加绝缘层

shots.section_title: 导线等于导体加绝缘层
shots.scene: 铝芯和铜芯两根导线对比
shots.prompt_en: Two wires: one with an aluminum core and a coin icon, one with a copper core and a lightning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 图省钱选铝，要导电好选铜。

shots.scene: 电流箭头只在铜芯里流动，外皮挡住
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway wire with current arrows flowing only in the copper core, blocked by the sleeve. No people.
shots.narration: 绝缘层让电流只在导体里走。

shots.scene: 小研捏着导线绝缘外皮插入接线孔（电源已断开）
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a wire by its insulation and plugs it into a terminal on a switched-off board.
shots.narration: 它保护人，也方便拿取和接线。

shots.scene: 实验台上一排不同颜色、长短的连接导线
shots.prompt_en: A rack of connecting leads in different colors and lengths on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 连接导线种类多，按电路选用。

shots.scene: 圆形调压器剖面：一个线圈绕在铁心上，有滑动触点
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a round variable autotransformer: a single coil wound on a laminated iron core with a sliding contact. No people.
shots.narration: 自耦调压器只有一个绕组。

shots.scene: 转动旋钮，输出电压条平滑上升
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a knob turning and an output bar rising smoothly. No people.
shots.narration: 转动旋钮，交流电压平滑可调。

shots.scene: 单个绕组上，输入和输出共用一部分线圈
shots.prompt_en: A schematic icon of a single winding with input across the whole coil and output taken from part of it, sharing one end. No people.
shots.narration: 原边和副边连在同一个绕组上。

shots.scene: 普通变压器两个独立线圈 vs 自耦变压器一个线圈
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a transformer with two separate coils and a gap between them, and an autotransformer with one shared coil. No people.
shots.narration: 所以它不能把输出和电网隔开。

shots.scene: 铜线卷变小、钱币图标
shots.prompt_en: A smaller copper coil icon next to a coin stack icon with a plus sign. No people.
shots.narration: 好处是省铜、经济。

shots.scene: 电压指针在设定线附近保持稳定
shots.prompt_en: A voltage gauge needle holding steady at a set line while input arrows vary. No people.
shots.narration: 它用来调整电压，或让电压保持稳定。

shots.scene: 单相调压器正面：输入插头、两个输出接线柱、旋钮和刻度
shots.prompt_en: The front of a single-phase variable autotransformer: a power cord with plug, two output terminals, a big knob and a blank dial scale. No people.
shots.narration: 单相调压器：插头接电源输入。

shots.scene: 输入端标相线和中性线两个空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The input side of the autotransformer with two blank tags for line and neutral. No people.
shots.narration: 输入端分相线和中性线。

shots.scene: 旋钮转动，输出端电压随刻度变化
shots.prompt_en: The knob turning and the dial pointer moving, an arrow from the output terminals. No people.
shots.narration: 转旋钮，输出端电压随之改变。

shots.scene: 一台圆形单相调压器和一台高大的三相调压器并排
shots.prompt_en: A round single-phase autotransformer next to a tall three-phase autotransformer with three stacked coils. No people.
shots.narration: 调压器有单相和三相两种。

shots.scene: 三相电路图标连到三相调压器
shots.prompt_en: A three-phase circuit icon connected to the three-phase autotransformer. No people.
shots.narration: 做三相实验，就用三相调压器。

shots.scene: 两块空白铭牌，旁边是电压和电流图标
shots.prompt_en: Two blank nameplates, each with a voltage icon and a current icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用前先看铭牌的电压和电流额定值。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着调压器的空白名牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank name tag beside a variable autotransformer.
shots.narration: 自耦调压器，实验室常简称调压器。

shots.scene: 导体、导线、调压器三个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three icons light up one by one: a conductor, a wire and an autotransformer. No people.
shots.narration: 导体、绝缘、导线规格和调压器，都讲了。

shots.section_title: 调压器输出不是安全电压
shots.scene: 调压器输出端只调低一点，但仍有闪电符号连到电网
shots.prompt_en: An autotransformer turned low, its output terminal still linked by a lightning symbol line back to the mains plug. No people.
shots.narration: 调压器不隔离，输出调低也可能带电网电位。
overlay: 调压器输出不是安全电压

shots.section_title: 调压器输出不是安全电压
shots.scene: 用手碰调压器输出端的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand touching the autotransformer output terminals, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通电时，不碰输出端和接线柱。

shots.section_title: 调压器输出不是安全电压
shots.scene: 调压器当隔离电源用的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an autotransformer labeled with a shield symbol, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能把它当隔离电源、安全电源用。

shots.scene: 旋钮指向零位，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An autotransformer knob turned to the zero position with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 通电前，旋钮先回零。

shots.scene: 小研盯着电压表，慢慢转动旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student watches a voltmeter while slowly turning the autotransformer knob.
shots.narration: 看着电压表，慢慢升到所需电压。

shots.scene: 电流指针接近红线，旋钮停止
shots.prompt_en: A current gauge needle approaching a red line, and the knob stopping. No people.
shots.narration: 电流不超过调压器的额定值。

shots.scene: 实验结束：旋钮回零，再拉下开关
shots.prompt_en: End of experiment icons: the knob returned to zero, then the power switch turned off. No people.
shots.narration: 用完先回零，再断电。

shots.scene: 老李逐根检查导线的绝缘层和插头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects connecting leads one by one, checking insulation and plugs.
shots.narration: 导线用前，先查绝缘层有没有破损。

shots.scene: 露铜丝、接头松动的导线被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wire with bare copper strands and a loose connector, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 露铜、松头、烧焦的线，一律不用。

shots.scene: 破损导线放进空白的待修盒
shots.prompt_en: Damaged wires placed into a blank repair box. No people.
shots.narration: 挑出来交给老师，不自己缠胶布凑合。

shots.scene: 接头插牢拧紧的特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a connecting plug pushed fully into a terminal and the terminal screw tightened. No people.
shots.narration: 接头插牢拧紧，松了会发热打火。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 阿杰拉下实验台开关，调压器插头拔下，再接线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the bench power and unplugs the autotransformer before wiring.
shots.narration: 接线、改线、拆线，一律先断电。
overlay: 断电接线，教师检查后通电

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 王老师对照电路图逐根检查导线
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks each wire against a blank circuit diagram.
shots.narration: 接好后，请指导教师检查线路。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 王老师点头，阿杰插上电源、合闸
shots.prompt_en: After the safety administrator nods, the young male student plugs in and switches on.
shots.narration: 老师同意了，才能合闸通电。

shots.section_title: 断电接线，教师检查后通电
shots.scene: 通电时伸手改线的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand moving a wire on a powered board, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不带电改线，有问题先断电。

shots.scene: 一根导线外皮发软冒烟
shots.prompt_en: A connecting wire on the bench with softened insulation and thin smoke rising. No people.
shots.narration: 导线发烫、冒烟、有焦味？

shots.scene: 小研立刻拉下电源开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student immediately switches off the bench power.
shots.narration: 立即切断电源，不要去拔线。

shots.scene: 向冒烟导线泼水的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water thrown onto a smoking wire, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电气起火，不能用水浇。

shots.scene: 老李用二氧化碳灭火器扑灭小火
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts out a small flame on the bench with a carbon dioxide extinguisher.
shots.narration: 断电后，用干粉或二氧化碳灭火器。

shots.scene: 火势变大，众人撤离，保卫处值班员打电话
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows; everyone leaves under an exit sign while the security officer calls on a phone.
shots.narration: 控制不住就撤离，拨打 119。

shots.scene: 阿杰触电倒在台边，小研冲去拉下总闸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slumps beside the bench after an electric shock; the female graduate student rushes to pull the main switch.
shots.narration: 有人触电，先切断电源。

shots.scene: 徒手拉人的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand grabbing a person being shocked, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 断电前，不能徒手去拉。

shots.scene: 老周打电话，老李在旁照护
shots.prompt_en: The older man calls on a mobile phone with a blank screen while the facility engineer, trained in first aid, attends to the young male student.
shots.narration: 拨打 120，受过培训的人施救。

shots.scene: 小研向王老师报告，保卫处值班员记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the safety administrator while the security officer writes on a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 铜、铝、铁三种导线和截面圆
shots.prompt_en: Icons of copper, aluminum and galvanized iron wires with cross-section circles. No people.
shots.narration: 按材料和载流量选导线，粗线电阻小。

shots.scene: 导线剖面和打勾的检查放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A wire cutaway icon and a magnifying glass with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 导线是导体加绝缘，用前先检查。

shots.scene: 调压器旋钮回零、不隔离警示两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an autotransformer knob at zero, and an autotransformer with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 调压器不隔离：回零、缓升、用完回零。

shots.scene: 断电开关、老师检查、灭火器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a switched-off power switch, a teacher checking a circuit, and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 断电接线，查过再通电，异常先断电。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的导线架和调压器旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy rack of connecting leads and an autotransformer with its knob at zero.
